statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease (I25.10)
The patient has a history of transient ischemic attack (Z86.73)
There is concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia contributing to these symptoms
The service is to capture intermittent arrhythmic events over an extended monitoring period
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial is based on lack of required precertification or authorization prior to service delivery
